title: Application Fleet Basis for Weather Stoppages, Reschedules and Cancellations on Custom Application and Field Services Plans
content:
Field conditions stop work under Custom Application and Field Services and nobody is charged for that.

A pass moved because of weather, equipment failure or a product shortage is rescheduled at no charge however many times it happens, and only a move the member asks for counts against the programme's free reschedule count; beyond that count a member-requested move carries the programme's reschedule charge.

| Reason the pass was moved | Counts against the programme's free reschedule count | Carries a charge |
|---|---|---|
| Weather | No | No, however many times it happens |
| Equipment failure | No | No, however many times it happens |
| Product shortage | No | No, however many times it happens |
| The member asked for the move | Yes | Only once the free count is used up, and then at the programme's reschedule charge |

**Cancelling a scheduled pass.** Cancelling inside the programme's notice in hours carries the cancellation charge, and outside it carries nothing.

**A pass washed out by rain.** Where a pass is washed out by rain after the product is down, whether the rerun is charged again is fixed by the programme rather than argued at the counter.

**A hold across the plan.** A weather hold across the whole plan is set when conditions stop work generally and runs no longer than the programme's hold maximum in calendar days from the day it was set, after which the plan returns to active and orders are rescheduled or released.

**Acres on an abandoned pass.** Acres on an abandoned pass go back into the queue and are not billed twice when the pass is finished later.

## Points of judgement

*A member on a programme allowing 2 free reschedules has had three passes moved for rain and now asks to move a fourth for their own reasons.* The three rain moves do not count against the free count, so the member's own move is the first that counts and it falls inside the free count of 2. No reschedule charge arises on it.

*A pass is cancelled by the member on a programme whose notice is 24 hours, with 30 hours still to run before the scheduled pass.* The cancellation is outside the notice period, so it carries nothing.
